verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud provider, so managed Postgres with point-in-time recovery, replicas and high availability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions Postgres, point-in-time recovery, database replicas or high-availability failover. The only replica claim ("add replicas with load balancing") covers application service scaling, not managed database replication, and the generic "provision infrastructure" line does not establish managed Postgres.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability
